name: Backspin out with Pad FX
lesson:
## Spin it back, cut before it comes round

Assign Pad FX A5 to Backspin. On beat 4 of bar 12 press it; on the one of bar 13 kill A's fader, play B and push its fader up. The spin sound lasts a beat and then the track would restart at speed, which is why the fader cut has to happen before that.

On a controller the pad does what a hand on a turntable does: winds the track backwards with a pitch dive. The pad version is repeatable and always the same length, which makes it easier to time than the real thing, so the score here is strict: the pad on beat 4, the cut and the new track inside a quarter beat of the one.
